title: agentic-forge plugin config
description: Plugin configuration (ADR 0041). The SAME schema validates two files: the user-level ~/.agentic-forge/config.json (cross-project, ADR 0049) and the per-repo <repo>/.agentic-forge/config.json. Precedence: built-in defaults < user-level < per-repo < env vars. All keys are optional; omitted keys fall back to built-in defaults. A committed example with every key lives at plugin/config.example.json (see docs/configuration.md). These files are COMMITTED — do not put secrets (API keys, tokens) in them; use env vars for those.

subagent_budget.description: Task-spawn caps; soft should be <= hard (soft warns, hard blocks).

external_reviewer.description: External reviewer CLI (increment 2). `command` is the executable name only (e.g. "codex") — not a shell line, and never an API key/secret (this file is committed). `command`, `isolated`, `model` and `effort` are honoured from the user-level file only; a repo file's values are ignored with a warning (ADR 0100).

enabled.description: Run the external reviewer. On by default; content goes to a third party when it runs. With it false the skills' review() runs nothing. A repo config cannot turn on a user-level false, and may turn it off, with a warning if that overrides a user-level true. A repo's false is kept if its file is dropped and still clearly says so; a file that cannot be decoded at all cannot say so, and then the reviewer stays on (ADR 0100).

command.description: A bare executable name on PATH (e.g. "codex") — not a path or shell line. Honoured from the user-level file only: a value in a repo file is ignored with a warning, because the operator chooses the program (ADR 0100). A value that is not a bare name falls back to the default with a warning. Enforced in code, not here: a schema failure would drop the whole file, `isolated` included.

isolated.description: Run the reviewer without the operator's user config and without persisting session files (ADR 0100): codex `exec --ignore-user-config --ephemeral`, on top of the read-only sandbox. Off by default. When the CLI cannot honour it the review is SKIPPED, never run without it. Honoured from the user-level file only: a value in a repo file is ignored with a warning, because it would drop the operator's whole CLI config. Not a stronger sandbox than those flags provide.

model.description: Model passed as `--model`. Null leaves the choice to the CLI; `isolated` ignores the user config, so set this there if you relied on the configured model. Honoured from the user-level file only: a value in a repo file is ignored with a warning (ADR 0100). An invalid string (it must match ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:-]{0,127}$) is treated as unset with a warning. Enforced in code, not by a pattern here: a schema failure would drop the whole file, `isolated` included.

effort.description: Reasoning effort passed as `-c model_reasoning_effort="<value>"`. Null leaves the choice to the CLI. Same rules as `model`: user-level only, and an invalid string is treated as unset with a warning, enforced in code (ADR 0100).

pr_watcher.description: PR watcher (ADR 0044/0045; autonomous mode 0063). Off by default; outward GitHub writes (push/reply/resolve/merge) are opt-in. Never force-pushes.

repos.description: owner/name repos the scheduled hourly job watches (empty = none).

auto_merge.description: Let the watcher merge a PR once the merge gate opens (ADR 0063). OFF by default — merging is irreversible and outward-facing.

merge_method.description: How auto_merge merges. Reaches argv as --<method>, so it is an enum here and clamped again in the library.

poll_seconds.description: Autonomous re-check cadence in seconds (default 600 = 10 min). This is ALSO the window an external PR reviewer gets: the gate cannot open before the first post-CI poll, so shortening it shortens that window.

auto_watch.description: Let the PR-created hook ENQUEUE a new PR for the scheduled watch (ADR 0068/0069). ON by default, but requires `enabled` too — with the watcher off the queue file is never created. Merging still requires auto_merge, which stays off: watching without merging is the safe middle setting.

max_ticks.description: How many drains one queued PR may consume before it is dropped (default 144 = 24 h at the 10-minute cadence). Nothing is watched forever.

state.description: Where the plugin writes GENERATED state — logs, queues, job state (ADR 0072). Default: ~/.agentic-forge/state/<repo>/. This file itself is repo-scoped configuration and is unaffected.

in_repo.description: Write generated state into <repo>/.agentic-forge/ instead of the user-level default. Off: a fresh run adds no untracked path to your repo. User-level file only: a value in a repo file is ignored with a warning (ADR 0102).

allow_external_vault.description: Read and write a vault that resolves outside the repo, for a vault kept elsewhere and reached by a link. Default false, because a checkout can commit that link. User-level file only: a value in a repo file is ignored with a warning (ADR 0102).

enabled.description: Write an audit record per tool call. On by default — it is the only record of what the agent did.

max_bytes.description: Rotate the audit log once it exceeds this size. Default 10 MiB.

keep_bytes.description: Bytes of the most recent records to keep in the live log when rotating. Default 5 MiB; the rest is gzipped into an archive beside it (see archives).

archives.description: How many gzipped archives of rotated-out records to keep beside the live log. Default 6; 0 discards them instead.

pre_router.description: The deterministic pre-router hook (ADR 0089): on each prompt, a lexical classifier over the skills' own trigger examples names the clearly-matching skill in the prompt's context. Suggests only, never invokes.

enabled.description: Default false: measured at +0.095 activation over the SessionStart note (inside single-run noise) on a stand ADR 0090 found empty, so the null result is uninterpretable; stays off per ADR 0091. Overridable with AGENTIC_FORGE_PRE_ROUTER.

routing_note.description: The SessionStart note telling the session that agentic-forge skills are workflows to invoke (2026.9.3). On by default.

enabled.description: Default true. Overridable with AGENTIC_FORGE_ROUTING_NOTE — the switch the note's own A/B uses (ADR 0092).
